---
title: Eggs with Cream
id: MAR-0078
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 20
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 8 eggs
- 1 dl fresh cream
- 50 g butter
- to taste Salt and pepper
## Method
1. Crack the eggs into a bowl, salt them and beat them with a fork.
2. Add the cream, half the softened butter in flakes, pepper and beat lightly.
3. Heat a non-stick pan and pour in the mixture.
4. Cook stirring continuously for 4 minutes.
5. Add the remaining butter in small pieces and continue stirring until you get a soft cream.
6. Serve the cream with hot croutons.
